title: Budget dashboard backend (Express + SQLite)
assumptions: No auth/single-user. SQLite file DB via better-sqlite3. No frontend, backend only.
rationale: Built Express + better-sqlite3 backend with layered structure (routes -> controllers -> models -> db). Modules: categories (CRUD), transactions (CRUD with filters/pagination), budgets (CRUD + spent/remaining/percentUsed per month), overview (summary + monthly trends). Zod validation middleware on all inputs, centralized ApiError + errorHandler for consistent JSON error responses, seed script for sample data. No auth (single-user, per user's choice). Verified via live curl smoke test: health, category list, overview summary, budget utilization, transaction list/create/validation-error/404, and monthly trends all returned correct JSON.
